map.输入功率、小链轮转速、齿数，计算推荐节距、链速、圆周力并校核强度: Enter the power, small-sprocket speed and tooth count to compute the recommended pitch, chain speed and circumferential force and check the strength
map.💡 链速 v=z₁n₁p/(60×1000)；圆周力 F=1000P/v；传动比: 💡 Chain speed v=z₁n₁p/(60×1000); circumferential force F=1000P/v; transmission ratio i=z₂/z₁; recommended center distance a₀=40p
map.小链轮齿数 z₁ 推荐：滚子链 ≥17，最佳 19~25，奇数较好: Recommended small-sprocket tooth count z₁: ≥17 for roller chain, ideally 19-25, an odd number being preferable
map.链速 v<0.6m/s 为低速链传动，v>12m/s 属高速链传动: A chain speed v<0.6 m/s is low-speed chain drive and v>12 m/s is high-speed chain drive
map.大链轮齿数不宜超过120，否则链条磨损后易脱链: The large-sprocket tooth count should not exceed 120, otherwise the worn chain tends to jump off
map.推荐节距按小链轮转速经验选取，实际需查功率曲线校核: The recommended pitch is chosen empirically from the small-sprocket speed; in practice the power curve must be checked
map.📚 深度解析：链传动/节距选型: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Chain Drive / Pitch Selection
map.由小轮转速推荐链节距 p。: Recommend the chain pitch p from the small-sprocket speed.
map.小轮转速 n1=1000 rpm：推荐节距 p≈某标准（如 12.7/15.87: Small-sprocket speed n1=1000 rpm: recommended pitch p≈a standard value (such as the 12.7/15.875 mm series); taking p=15.875 → center distance a0=40×15.875≈635 mm.
map.节距越大承载越高？: Does a larger pitch carry more load?
map.是，但节距大、多边形效应强、噪声与冲击大，高速宜用小节距多齿数。: Yes, but a large pitch has a strong polygon effect and high noise and impact; high speed favours a small pitch and more teeth.
map.中心距为何取 40p？: Why take the center distance as 40p?
map.经验推荐初选 a0≈30–50 倍节距，兼顾包角与松边垂度，最终按结构微调。: Experience recommends a preliminary a0≈30-50 times the pitch, balancing the wrap angle and slack-side sag, and finally fine-tuned to the structure.
